blocks.content: Quiz: What is a doubly linked list?
Tap an option below to answer:
A data structure where each node contains a reference to the next node.
This describes a singly linked list where each node has a reference to the next node.
This describes a singly linked list where each node has a reference to the next node.
A data structure where each node contains a reference to the previous node.
This describes a characteristic of a doubly linked list, but it is not a complete description.
This describes a characteristic of a doubly linked list, but it is not a complete description.
A data structure where each node contains both a reference to the next node and the previous node.
This accurately describes a doubly linked list with references to both the next and previous nodes.
This accurately describes a doubly linked list with references to both the next and previous nodes.
A data structure where each node contains only the data value.
This describes a simple data value, not a linked list structure.
This describes a simple data value, not a linked list structure.
